verdict.rationale: Fellow lets you create multiple named API keys, one per application, and distinguishes user-level keys from workspace and super-admin keys. Its MCP server is limited to data the user can already access, and admins choose which MCP tools assistants may use and can revoke connections. That gives tiered, revocable agent credentials, but the evidence shows no per-key permission scopes, read-only keys or endpoint-level restriction. missing for 10: per-credential scope/permission selection (e.g., read-only or resource-limited keys), per-key expiry, documented per-key revocation for API keys, independent corroboration.
